thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the bottom three-eighths of the image height is one clean continuous surface — a smooth plain floor — rendered simply and evenly with nothing on it, and every character, object, prop, effect and action is composed entirely within the upper five-eighths above it. Anything the characters hold or stand on sits at mid height, never near the bottom edge. Tight face-centred framing, camera straight on at eye level, the frame split in three. On the LEFT, small and set back, a neighbourhood street map pinned to a wall, dozens of hand-drawn red circles clustered over one single cheap block of streets and none anywhere else, with a tiny sphere wrapped edge to edge in the Chinese flag — red field with one large yellow star and four smaller stars — in a dark business suit standing before it, back turned, one glove raised to add another circle. In the CENTRE at mid height, an open passport, a banded brick of banknotes and a folded registry printout whose price line is ringed in red, the figure "6억" printed clearly on it. On the RIGHT, filling the right half of the frame, a sphere wrapped edge to edge in the South Korean flag — white field with a red-and-blue taeguk circle at the centre and four black trigrams — in a white shirt with rolled sleeves, its huge eyes screwed shut with tears squeezing out at the corners, mouth open in a strained grimace, both small black gloves hanging limp at its sides, shaking motion lines and small blue despair streaks around its surface. Blurred Korean low-rise apartment rooftops and a pale overcast sky far behind. Glossy semi-3D rendered illustration with a polished anime finish: smooth volumetric shading, strong specular highlights, soft ambient occlusion, clean bold outlines, vivid saturated colors, bright cinematic key light with sparkle and lens-flare accents, shallow depth of field on the background. Characters are "countryball" style spheres — a perfectly round glossy ball rendered with realistic sphere volume and a bright highlight, its entire surface wrapped edge to edge in its identity mark (an accurate national flag for a country, or the company's actual logo and brand color for a corporation), with large expressive cartoon eyes and mouth drawn directly on that surface, attached to a small human body in a business suit, work uniform, or military uniform, with small black gloved hands. The identity mark stays large and unbroken so it reads instantly at thumbnail size. Expressions are extreme and instantly readable at small size. The machinery, vehicles, and industrial objects in the scene are rendered with crisp mechanical detail and realistic metallic materials, contrasting against the stylized spheres.
